summary: Defines search criteria and controller logic to retrieve assignment-related data for worksheet assignment workflows. Implements data models and logic to populate criteria via database procedures, handling multiple fields needed for program, course, cohort, term, and student matching in placement workflows.
purpose: To encapsulate and retrieve worksheet assignment search criteria, including program, course, term, and cohort details, as well as operational parameters for student matching, preferences, and request code management, via a structured controller and database access pattern.

workflows.name: RetrieveWorksheetAssignSearchCriteria
steps: Set up database procedure call with parameters: CohortID, TermID, CourseID
Execute procedure and read main result set
Populate fields of WorksheetAssignSearchCriteria from database result
Check for additional result set and populate StudentCountForSection

workflows.name: CheckWorksheetPRsExist
steps: Set up database procedure call with parameters: GroupFlag, CohortID, TermID, CourseID
Read result set for PRsExist, OffersExist, ConfirmedCount

business_rules: WorksheetAssignSearchCriteria is populated only if database procedure returns results
StudentCountForSection is only populated if second result set is present
validations: All database fields are validated via data reader methods (GetString, GetBoolean, GetInt, GetDateTime)
PRSelectorEndDate and LocalDateTime default to DateTime.MaxValue if not present
calculations: OffersExist and ConfirmedCount returned and calculated within WorksheetPRsExist
conditions: Second result set present: StudentCountForSection is updated
system_behavior: Populates entity fields from database procedure based on parameters
Returns structured entity for worksheet assignment workflows
Checks existence of PRs and counts for offers and confirmations
exceptions: If no result set is returned, entity fields remain default
If StudentCountForSection not present, field remains default
content_gaps: Details on field value ranges, detailed business logic for assignment criteria, and edge cases for database procedure execution are not specified.
